Important: Loss of suction may occur if foam filters are not cleaned every three (3) months. Rinse and allow to air dry completely.

Directions for Washable foam and felt pre-filter replacement kit:1) With the dust cup removed, pull the two (2) filters out from the top of the motor base.2) Rinse the filters thoroughly in lukewarm water until the water runs clear.3) Squeeze out excess water and let air-fry for at least 24 hours before inserting back into the vacuum.
